_meta.description: Claims, calculations and editorial heuristics with explicit provenance and review status. A source link is not itself verification. Decision-model assumptions and source-backed tax inputs are maintained in _decision_model.

sebi_brokerage_cap_cash.label: SEBI Base Expense Brokerage Cap (Cash)
sebi_brokerage_cap_cash.effective_period: 2026 Regulations effective 1 April 2026; consolidated amendments through 10 October 2026
sebi_brokerage_cap_cash.assumptions: Brokerage up to 6 bps for cash trades or 2 bps for derivatives, measured against trade value, may sit outside the base expense ratio (BER). tax_sec_56_2_xii_reit_repayment.label: REIT/InvIT Debt Repayment Taxation Section
tax_sec_56_2_xii_reit_repayment.effective_period: Tax year 2026–27; Income-tax Act, 2025 as amended by Finance Act, 2026
tax_sec_56_2_xii_reit_repayment.assumptions: The taxable specified sum is max(A − B − C, 0). A is qualifying distributions paid so far to current and previous holders; B is the unit’s issue price, not its secondary-market purchase price; C is amounts already taxed under this clause. Some pass-through components are excluded, and cost-basis rules also matter. Not every debt repayment is immediately taxable.

_decision_model.scope: Educational review for individuals in the displayed 20s–50s age brackets. Self-selected ordinary-income marginal rates; not a tax-return calculator or full financial plan.
_decision_model.illustration_assumptions: This example puts all the extra interest in one tax band and adds 4% health and education cess. It assumes no surcharge, rebate, tax relief, deductions or exemptions. It does not cover capital gains or income that crosses tax bands. It is not your total tax bill or a forecast of returns.

risk_answers.limited: A loss would make it harder to pay essential bills
risk_answers.comfortable: I could handle a loss without missing essential bills
risk_answers.unsure: I have not worked this out yet

_decision_model.policy_note: The time ranges, debt threshold and order of checks are Sparkfolio’s guides, not rules set by a regulator. Your age alone does not decide an investment mix, and your answers have not been independently checked. These answers are not a full assessment of how much investment risk you can take.
